members.title: CE use_double=True + use_fast=True crashes the CUDA context ('misaligned address') whenever (mag_bins+1)*phase_bins is odd
members.evidence: ce.cu:144-145: `unsigned int r = ((nmag * nphase + nphase) * sizeof(unsigned int)) % sizeof(FLT); FLT * Hc = (FLT *)&block_bin_phi[nphase + r];` -- r is a BYTE remainder (4 when (nmag+1)*nphase is odd and FLT=double) but is used as an ELEMENT offset (4 uints = 16 bytes), so Hc starts at byte (nmag*nphase+nphase)*4+16, which is 4 mod 8: misaligned for double.
